# head

Print the beginning of files or standard input through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/head input.txt

moonx cli/head -n 3 input.txt

moonx cli/head -c 16 input.bin
```

Print ten lines by default. Use -n for lines or -c for bytes; negative counts omit that many records or bytes from the end.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | Suppress file headers. |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | Always show file headers. |
| `-z`, `--zero-terminated` | Use NUL-delimited records. |
| `-n VALUE`, `--lines VALUE` | Select N records. Default: `10`. |
| `-c VALUE`, `--bytes VALUE` | Select N bytes. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

Workspace builds use the MoonBit 2026-11-26 toolchain.

- Counts and supported size suffixes must fit the command's Int64 range.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
